Continuous batching in practice

Continuous batching schedules requests at the granularity of a single decoding iteration rather than a whole request.

When one sequence finishes, a waiting request immediately takes its slot, so the GPU stays busy and tail latency drops.

The scheduler has to balance prefill and decode work, and it must keep the KV cache from overflowing when many long prompts arrive together.
